abstract: Durable skills like critical thinking, creativity, and collaboration are essential for innovation, yet teaching them remains difficult. In this work, we focus on the entrepreneurial domain, where these skills and others are required, and ask whether AI can be used as a tool for improving entrepreneurial proficiency. As a first step towards this challenge, we present an extension of Vantage, a platform developed at Google Research, adapted to serve as an interactive practice environment for entrepreneurship. Vantage pairs students with simulated AI peers engineered to navigate realistic business scenarios and challenge learners to exercise key skills. In a randomized controlled trial (RCT) embedded in summer entrepreneurship programs run by The Network for Teaching Entrepreneurship (NFTE), students using Vantage scored significantly higher on their Capstone Business Plans than control students with access to standard AI tools. These preliminary findings suggest that orchestrated AI peers can meaningfully support short-term performance on tasks requiring complex, durable skills.

ob.tldr: 为检验AI能否提升创业能力，研究者将Vantage改造为包含逼真商业情境和编排式AI同伴的互动练习环境，并在NFTE暑期创业项目中开展随机对照试验。使用该平台的学生在顶点商业计划评分上显著优于仅使用标准AI工具的对照组，显示出短期促进作用。

title: Improving Entrepreneurial Skills by Practicing with AI
title_zh: 通过 AI 实践提升创业技能
